name: The Westin Perth
positioning: Westin hotel in Perth's east end above Hibernian Place, with a level 5 outdoor pool, a BODHI spa and Guy Grossi's Garum
best_for: City-break travelers who want to walk to Elizabeth Quay, Kings Park and Northbridge
Couples wanting a suite with city views
Food lovers interested in Roman-style Italian dining

facts.text: Elizabeth Quay, Kings Park, the Art Gallery of WA and the nightlife of Northbridge and the CBD are a short walk away.
Hibernian Place, with its cafes and restaurants, is on the hotel's doorstep.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in natural light.
Westin Executive suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with city views.
The Westin Club Lounge offers breakfast, evening drinks and canapes, and all-day use with tea, coffee and refreshments.
Haven Lounge serves a seasonal High Tea.
The Westin Workout Fitness Studio has TRX functional training equipment.
The hotel has a Strava running map with a running route through Perth city.

highlights.text: The outdoor pool is on level 5, with a heated outdoor rain shower.
The hotel is home to BODHI Westin, a holistic wellness spa.
The Presidential Suite is on the top floor, with a balcony, sauna, separate lounge, dining area and kitchen.
The hotel is in Perth's east end, towering over Hibernian Place, a short stroll from the city's shopping, business, dining and cultural hub.
Garum is a Roman osteria by chef Guy Grossi, housed in historic Hibernian Hall.

considerations.text: Club Lounge evening drinks and canapes are for guests 18 and over; children are welcome at other times.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may not suit guests seeking a quiet retreat.
